assertions.text: Output contains a @TableTest annotation
assertions.evidence: Multiple @TableTest(...) annotations present in all three test methods

assertions.text: Email validation and name-required error scenarios are present — at least one row for invalid email and one for missing name.
assertions.evidence: Rows include 'Null name' with blank name, and 'Email missing @', 'Email missing domain part', 'Email missing local part'

assertions.text: Dietary requirements and/or accessibility needs use blank cells (null) when not provided — not 'N/A' or 'none'.
assertions.evidence: In acceptsOptionalFields table: 'Both optional fields null' row shows blank cells for both columns

assertions.text: When testing pricing rules, irrelevant inputs use value sets or representative values — not blanks.
assertions.evidence: Pricing table uses {1, 4} and {5, 10} value sets for groupSize; optional fields not shown as columns

assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: All three tables have 'Scenario' as the first column

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?'
assertions.evidence: Pricing table has 'Price?' column; validation table has 'Error?' column

assertions.text: Column names use domain/business language, not code identifiers.
assertions.evidence: Columns: Scenario, Dietary Requirements, Accessibility Needs, Name, Email, Error?, Registration Date, Group Size, Price?

assertions.text: Scenario names describe conditions, not outcomes.
assertions.evidence: Examples: 'Null name', 'Early-bird only', 'Group discount only' describe input conditions, not outcomes like '20% off'

assertions.text: Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: All three method bodies contain only register() call and assertions; no control flow

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName, @Description, @TableTest
assertions.evidence: All three methods follow the order: @DisplayName, @Description("..."), @TableTest(...)

assertions.text: Test method has either @DisplayName or descriptive method name
assertions.evidence: All three methods have @DisplayName: 'Optional fields...', 'Validation rejects...', 'Pricing applies...'

assertions.text: If @Description is present and longer than one line, use text block (triple quotes), not concatenation.
assertions.evidence: All @Description annotations use triple-quoted strings: @Description(\"\"\"...\"\"\")

assertions.text: Multiple tables address distinct concerns, not one monolithic table.
assertions.evidence: Three separate methods: acceptsOptionalFields, rejectsInvalidInputs, appliesDiscount

assertions.text: Each table has only rows needed to express its concern's rules.
assertions.evidence: Optional fields: 4 rows; Validation: 6 rows with boundary conditions; Pricing: 7 rows with key boundaries

assertions.text: Input validation and pricing are in separate @TableTest methods
assertions.evidence: rejectsInvalidInputs method tests validation; appliesDiscount method tests pricing

assertions.text: Validation @TableTest includes Dietary Requirements and Accessibility Needs columns, not hardcoded as null.
assertions.evidence: Validation method hardcodes optional fields: 'null, null, LocalDate.of(2025, 4, 1), 1'. Separate table used instead.

assertions.text: Registration date uses descriptive values (e.g. 'before cutoff'), not raw date literals like '2025-02-28'.
assertions.evidence: Table includes literal dates: '2025-03-01' and '2025-02-28' alongside descriptive values

assertions.text: If literal dates used, early-bird cutoff date appears as separate policy column
assertions.evidence: Literal dates present ('2025-02-28', '2025-03-01') but no cutoff-date column; cutoff only in @Description

assertions.text: @Description does not restate discount rules already visible in table or list fixed input values.
assertions.evidence: Restates rules: 'Early-bird: 20% off...', 'Group: 15% off...' and lists values: 'name is "Alice Smith"...'

assertions.text: Output is 'Discount?' not 'Price?'; or if 'Price?' used, both 'Base price' and 'Price?' columns present.
assertions.evidence: Uses 'Price?' column without 'Base price' column; base price (£100) only in @Description

assertions.text: Each @TableTest method has a single, uniform assertion pattern for all rows.
assertions.evidence: Each method applies same assertions uniformly: acceptsOptionalFields uses assertTrue(isAccepted()); rejectsInvalidInputs checks both isAccepted and error

assertions.text: Optional-fields table includes output/expectation column asserting acceptance
assertions.evidence: acceptsOptionalFields table has no output column; only columns: Scenario, Dietary Requirements, Accessibility Needs

assertions.text: Scenario names do not redundantly include specific field values visible in table columns.
assertions.evidence: Scenario names describe conditions ('Null name', 'Early-bird only') without listing specific values like 'name: Alice, email: alice@...'
